question.text: What is the Commodity Transaction Tax (CTT) rate applicable on the sale of commodity futures and on the sale of commodity options on a recognized association?

answer.text: 0.01% on the seller of commodity futures and 0.05% on the seller of commodity options, with separate purchaser rates on exercise
0.01% on the seller of commodity options and 0.02% on the seller of commodity futures
No transaction tax applies to commodity derivatives in India
0.05% on both buyer and seller of all commodity derivative transactions

explanation.text: The Logic: CTT on non-agricultural commodity derivatives is levied at 0.01% on the seller of commodity futures and 0.05% on the seller of commodity options, with separate purchaser rates applying on exercise of options. The Trap: The seller-side CTT rates for futures and options are different; combining them or applying 0.01% to options is incorrect. Note: CTT applies to non-agricultural commodity derivatives on recognized associations; equity STT and CTT are separate regimes with different rates.
